title: VyaparPulse Transaction
description: Structured transaction as produced by the Voice AI module or any other valid application workflow (manual entry, etc.). See architecture doc section 24 for the source contract. 'merchant_id' is a Phase 1 addition, not present in the doc's illustrative example, required because every downstream layer (aggregation, features, health, credit) operates per-merchant.

merchant_id.description: Identifies which merchant this transaction belongs to. Enables merchant-level isolation (section 5).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the transaction, e.g. '2026-08-28T18:42:15'.

customer.description: Customer name/identifier if known. Optional — voice input may not always capture this.

items.description: Line items, if itemized. May be empty (per the doc's own example) when voice input only captures an amount.

amount.description: Total transaction value. Must be positive — a zero or negative amount is treated as an impossible value (section 5/21).

confidence.description: Voice-parsing confidence, when the transaction originated from the Voice AI module. Null for non-voice entry. ML-2 does not need to know the origin (section 24) but the field is preserved if present.
